title.zh: 量子隧穿 · 穿墙的是概率，不是子弹
title.en: Quantum Tunnelling · What Passes Through the Wall Is a Probability

desc.zh: 波撞上能量更高的墙：大部分被反弹，一小撮穿了过去——扫描隧道显微镜就靠这一小撮。
desc.en: A wave hits a wall higher than its energy: most of it bounces back and a small share gets through — and the scanning tunnelling microscope runs on that small share.
